note: GitHub items dated by trending snapshot date, not repo creation date.

items.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
items.summary: GitHub daily trending: a coding-agent skill from Cloudflare for multi-phase security audits, with independently verified, machine-readable findings. MIT licensed.

items.title: Mistral Voxtral 3
items.summary: New speech-to-text and text-to-speech models plus a LiveKit-based voice agent SDK: transcription in 50+ languages with diarization, expressive speech in 35+ languages, and sub-second turns. From $0.0035/min transcription and $13 per 1M characters for speech; EU-hosted API or self-deployment.

items.title: ElevenLabs Eleven Realtime
items.summary: Two speech-to-speech models that each act as a complete voice agent: v1 Mini for natural, low-cost conversations and v1 Max for complex, tool-heavy tasks. 90+ languages, 17,000+ voices, in ElevenAgents and an OpenAI Realtime-compatible API; rolling out gradually.

items.title: Bria Fibo 2
items.summary: Bria's new image generation and editing model, trained on 100% licensed data. Open weights for Generate and Edit on Hugging Face, and the same Bria API with no code changes.

items.title: i14 Sugar Glider 120B
items.summary: A 120B model on i14's constant-memory Cerbearus architecture that reads up to a million tokens with fixed memory per token, fitting many more long-context requests per server. Early access via waitlist, in i14's cloud, your VPC or on-premises.

items.title: stablyai/orca
items.summary: GitHub daily trending: a place for working with a fleet of coding agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription, on desktop, mobile or a remote runtime.

items.title: headroomlabs-ai/headroom
items.summary: GitHub daily trending: compresses tool outputs, logs, files and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM, claiming 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60-95% fewer for JSON. Library, proxy and MCP server.

items.title: Inception Mercury 3
items.summary: Inception's largest diffusion language model, claimed at 1,068 tokens/s on NVIDIA GPUs with a 1M-token context. $0.20/$0.70 per 1M input/output tokens (50% off at launch); OpenAI-compatible API, OpenRouter, Baseten and Vercel. Weights not released.

items.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
items.summary: MiniMax's next-generation Flash model for agentic tasks, coding, computer use and cybersecurity, revealed as the anonymous 'Space Bunny'. $0.15/$0.60 per 1M tokens via the MiniMax API, M Plan and MiniMax Code; weights to follow.

items.title: Cloudflare Clairic (preview)
items.summary: Cloudflare's first extraction model pulls typed values (text spans, numbers, dates, lists) from text or images and estimates or forecasts values with confidence scores, in one pass with no output tokens. Preview on Workers AI; open weights planned.

items.title: Viggle JST-2
items.summary: Viggle's physics-native world model generates explorable 3D scenes in about one second, plus animation-ready 3D characters and full-body motion from text, images or video. Free to try in the PINOC browser app.

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.summary: GitHub weekly trending: editorial diagram design for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and more), with 44 diagram types as self-contained HTML + SVG.

items.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio
items.summary: GitHub daily trending: an open-source, fully local ElevenLabs alternative for voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobook creation.

items.title: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
items.summary: GitHub daily trending: a job-search framework built on Claude Code that runs on your machine to evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters and prep interviews.

items.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
items.summary: A minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with better reasoning, coding, agentic and visual benchmark scores, faster task completion and shorter outputs. Live on DeepSeek's website, app and API, with open weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope.

items.title: GPT-6 Pro update in ChatGPT
items.summary: GPT-6 Pro in ChatGPT's chat tab now gives faster responses, makes better use of plugins and tools, and can run multiple agents on different parts of a task in parallel. Rolling out to eligible Pro users.

items.title: Reflection Beam (open weights)
items.summary: Reflection has released the weights for Beam, its first open-weight model: a 501B-parameter MoE (23B active) with a 1M-token context, built for coding and long-horizon agentic work. Apache 2.0, on Hugging Face.

items.title: Elorian Glimpse
items.summary: Elorian's first model, a visual-thinking model that reasons over images and video, uses multimodal tools and can coordinate subagents. Available via API and chat UI at $0.60/$3 per 1M tokens.

items.title: Perplexity pplx-decider-v1.2
items.summary: Perplexity's 27B decision model for text and images (Qwen3.8-27B backbone) returns typed probabilities for yes/no, choice and score questions, answering several questions about one input in a single pass. Weights on Hugging Face.

items.title: Junie Local on Windows and NVIDIA RTX Spark
items.summary: JetBrains' free, fully local Junie coding agent now runs on NVIDIA RTX Spark PCs and is stable on Windows with 24GB+ RTX GPUs. No token charges or quotas, and code never leaves the machine; choose Qwen3.6-27B or JetBrains' merged Qwen3.8-3.6-27B-blend.

items.title: Muse Spark Open
items.summary: Meta releases the weights for Muse Spark Open, a natively multimodal 816B-parameter (42B active) model with a 1M-token context, built for coding and agentic work. Runs on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios via MLX; Muse Model License.

items.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein
items.summary: Black Forest Labs' 5.6B open-weights model for text-to-image, editing and multi-reference generation (up to 10 images), with native 4K and bounding-box control. Runs on 8GB-VRAM GPUs with the INT8 build; also in the BFL API.

items.title: Liquid AI d1-ultra
items.summary: Liquid AI's multimodal decision model answers yes/no, choice and score questions about text and images with calibrated probabilities in one forward pass, without generating tokens. On the Liquid API at $0.042 per 1M input tokens.

items.title: Datadog Scout 1.0
items.summary: Datadog's first model specialised for investigating production incidents, powering its Bits Investigation SRE agent. Post-trained with RL on GLM-5.3 Flash; in closed preview with sign-up open.

items.title: StepFun Step 5 Preview (open weights)
items.summary: StepFun's flagship 600B-parameter MoE (27B active) for agentic work, with a 1M-token context and vision input, now released with open weights on Hugging Face after launching in StepFun's products and API.

items.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
items.summary: NVIDIA's open 120B-parameter multimodal model for always-on agents, available now on Hugging Face, OpenRouter, ModelScope and as NVIDIA NIM. Released alongside Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B for local 24GB systems.

items.title: Mistral Timestral
items.summary: Mistral's first family of time-series foundation models (5M to 209M parameters) for probabilistic, multivariate forecasting. Runs on CPU; Modified MIT licence.

items.title: Claude Code Review (GA)
items.summary: Anthropic's Code Review is out of research preview for Claude Team and Enterprise. Reviews run automatically on new PRs, now about 3x faster, with Quick, Standard or Deep levels per repository.

items.title: morluto/rea
items.summary: GitHub weekly trending: reverse-engineer apps down to native binaries with agents.

items.title: heygen-com/hyperframes
items.summary: GitHub weekly trending: write HTML, render video, built for agents.

items.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.summary: GitHub weekly trending: persistent cross-session memory for coding agents.

items.title: earthtojake/text-to-cad
items.summary: GitHub weekly trending: gives agents CAD capabilities.

items.title: Krea 3 (beta)
items.summary: Krea's new image editing model built for production: changes only what you ask, with native 2K output, box-based regional edits and up to eight reference images. Under 8 seconds and about $0.06 per edit; in the Krea app and API.

items.title: Ling-3.1-flash (open weights)
items.summary: Ant Group's inclusionAI published weights for Ling-3.1-flash, a 560B-parameter hybrid reasoning MoE (25B active) with a 1M-token context, aimed at agents, search, office work and software engineering. MIT licence.

items.title: Paper Instruments Ultramarine 1 Flash
items.summary: An agentic model for professional knowledge work (finance, law, consulting, operations), RL-trained on GLM-5.3 Flash; about $0.13 per task on its maker's internal suite. Available through an OpenAI-compatible API.

items.title: Grok Voice 3.0
items.summary: xAI's new speech-to-speech model, with sub-second latency, available today in the Voice Agent API at $0.08/min, the same price as Grok Voice 2.0.
